title: SecurityFinding
description: A security audit or automated scan finding related to a BibleFi smart contract, protocol component, or agent. Used to track vulnerabilities from discovery through remediation.

finding_id.description: Globally unique identifier for this security finding.

schema_version.description: Semantic version of the SecurityFinding schema (e.g. '1.0.0').

title.description: Short, descriptive title for the finding.

description.description: Detailed description of the vulnerability or issue.

severity.description: Severity classification. 'critical' represents findings that can lead to immediate, catastrophic loss of funds or protocol compromise.

status.description: Current remediation status of the finding.

target.description: The component or artefact affected by this finding.

identifier.description: Unique identifier for the target. For smart contracts, use the contract address; for agents, use the agent ID; for schemas, use the $id URI.

name.description: Human-readable name of the affected component.

chain_id.description: EVM chain ID if the target is a deployed smart contract.

file_path.description: Relative file path within the repository, if applicable.

line_range.description: Source code line range where the issue was found.

cwe_ids.description: Common Weakness Enumeration identifiers applicable to this finding (e.g. ['CWE-89', 'CWE-20']).

proof_of_concept.description: Optional code snippet, transaction hash, or narrative demonstrating exploitability.

recommendation.description: Suggested remediation steps or mitigation strategies.

references.description: External URLs to relevant advisories, write-ups, or documentation.

discovered_by.description: Identity of the auditor or tool that discovered the finding.

name.description: Name of the individual, firm, or automated tool.

contact.description: Email, GitHub handle, or other contact details for the discoverer.

resolution.description: Details of how and when the finding was resolved.

summary.description: Description of the fix or accepted-risk rationale.

commit_hash.description: Git commit hash where the fix was introduced.

tx_hash.description: On-chain transaction hash if the fix required a contract upgrade or migration.

resolved_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp when the finding was resolved.

resolved_by.description: Name or identifier of the person or team that resolved the finding.

discovered_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp when the finding was first identified.

updated_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp when this record was last updated.

tags.description: Optional tags for classification or filtering (e.g. 'reentrancy', 'access-control', 'oracle-manipulation').
